resolution_notes: auth_type: Original is incorrect. Official documentation requires an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials grant at POST /token, which returns a bearer access token: https://docs.tcgplayer.com/docs/getting-started. example: Original root request and API-key wording are incorrect; the same current official guide specifies v1.39.0, the bearer Authorization header, GET /catalog/categories, and the JSON response structure used here: https://docs.tcgplayer.com/docs/getting-started.
